headline: 2 Crossings, 1 Group Each Way
primaryText:
Oguz Khan crosses the Atlantic twice this season, and each crossing carries 1 group.

There are 2 crossings this season, 1 group each way. Once a direction is reserved, it is gone for this season.

Westbound: leaves Bodrum around 1 November 2026 and the Canary Islands around 13 November.
Eastbound: leaves Antigua around 15 April 2027.

Within 2 working days we send you a written outline of the routes, the itemised costs and the conditions. If the crossing suits your group, we can hold your dates on a conditional priority reservation.

From €180,000 for the whole yacht, plus catering and taxes.

Request the crossing details below.
whyItWorks: The video opens with a short, vertical text overlay promising something out of the ordinary, set over footage of a yacht cutting through open sea. The ad makes the scarcity concrete with exact departure dates, a fixed number of slots and a starting price, which filters out casual browsers and speaks to serious buyers. The low-friction next step (a written outline within two working days) makes enquiring feel easy for a high-ticket purchase.
